reviews.text: The team at the surgery are so amazing, they went above and beyond for our cat who was 24 years old. All the staff is so lovely and attentive, they made sure to answer any questions we had and even though his health wasn’t the best near the end. He was looked after and nothing was missed. As someone who has had multiple pets in the past at different practices. I can confidently say that this is the best one I’ve visited. When our cat passed, we were treated with such care and kindness, which was truly heartwarming. Thank you to all the staff at the surgery, you are brilliant.

They take good care of my cat. Always super friendly. They help with insurance forms too. Also were able to provide flea treatments that don't contain Neonicotinoids, which are much better for the environment and nature, which is a major plus.

The staff and vets here are so helpful and kind - we received a lot of support moving our cat overseas that made the whole experience less stressful! Especially thank you to Dr Miranda and Rachel at the front desk who were so calm and kind to our Spider!

A big thanks to Brodie and Tara for their caring and professional service that we received today. It had been a while since we last attended the surgery however our cockapoo unfortunately stood on some glass this morning, which we were unable to retrieve from his paw at home. The team were accommodating with fitting us in before they closed for the weekend and treated (a very anxious) Bear with thoughtful care and attention to remove the glass successfully. Being a dentist myself, it was clear to see that the team today communicate well and work efficiently together to make care and treatment for our pets as comfortable as possible - which makes a huge difference in healthcare. Thanks again Brodie and Tara.

My pet was registered at this practice for many years and over the past few years the service has changed a lot to worse. Starting from the way a vet is overcharging for tests that should not be even required for a healthy pet, to trying to tell the pet owner additional things are needed when in fact other vets disagree as my pet is perfectly healthy. Not to mention that the prices every year increase hugely (I understand prices raising but not in hundreds in just a year) this is unbelievable. I will be changing the vet in the upcoming weeks as it's really getting worse. And sadly, not all the vets in this practice are that friendly and approachable, puts me right off.
Forever grateful to the amazing team at Hyndland Street Vets

There are not enough words to express how wonderful the care we have received here at Hyndland St has been. Our two Siberian cats, Scout and Ellora, have been patients here for 10 years and each and every visit has been so full of love, gentleness and compassion. Whatever expectations we could’ve had have been far surpassed by the way our wee ones have been looked after! Every single one of the vets and nurses we have seen alike have such a wonderful manner, particularly with our more nervous Ellora (especially nurse Tara!) our cats could not be in better hands!

Hyndland Street Vets saved the day for our boy Lazare! After 4 years in Glasgow we were moving back to the US and Lazare was denied boarding on his flight from Frankfurt to St Louis because his travel documents went missing somewhere en route during his Edinburgh to Frankfurt flight. (Lufthansa!) On a very busy Friday before May Bank Holiday weekend — HSVS produced an original official heath certificate WITHIN HOURS so we could get him on the next flight. He’s with us a safe and sound now so I want to extend my sincere gratitude to HSVS for going above and beyond to help us. You all are THE BEST! Thank you!

As a pet owner I was deeply concerned by the way my pet was clinically assessed by one of the vets working at this practice.

As a result I raised my concern to the clinical director and practice manager, but when it was not addressed I had to raise my concerns with Vetpartners Group Ltd who are the owners of this practice.

The whole experience was extremely stressful. My pet found it traumatic, and it was incredibly upsetting for me. Since this happened I have registered my pet at a different veterinary practice and I'm trying to help my pet overcome its fear of vets.

This is why I am writing this review to warn other pet owners looking to register their pet at this practice. I would also encourage existing clients to raise any concerns of clinical assessments to the practice as well as Vetpartners Group Ltd (and when needed to the RCVS), and please remember you can always obtain a second opinion from a different vet at another practice if you are concerned by a clinical assessment.

Hope this review helps other pets and their owners to avoid what we experienced.

Fantastic vet practice with professional, caring, helpful and welcoming staff. We’ve been with the practice for nine years, bringing our various dogs and cats there. We have always received excellent veterinary care from Hyndland Street. Highly recommended.

Thank you to Hyndland Street Vet Surgery for accommodating a very flustered owner and dog on Friday evening. I arrived in a real tizzy with my dog and a suspected mouse poison ingestion. They treated him straight away and kept their cool while I had a meltdown.
Special thanks to Tara and Brodie. Not knowing the type of poison potentially ingested or being able to answer that question which they insisted on knowing was frustrating and increased my panic. £250 for a vomit inducing drug as a precaution was a worthwhile spend for peace of mind but the fact that they needed to know the exact type is a lesson I'll never forget. To be clear, as I learned,  a vet practice doesn't necessarily know the standard types of products used by Glasgow City Council pest control and will need to know exact ingredients. Keep any info handy as they will need that for diagnosing and treating. Lessons learned!
Thank you again
